</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ High tier (T85+) weapons: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/796989662983094275.png?v=1" alt="annihilation" title="annihilation" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1" alt="deathguard90" title="deathguard90" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809239255658587.png?v=1" alt="skulllantern90" title="skulllantern90" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
⬥ 25+ Prayer bonus. Dragon Rider armour is an easy way to achieve this
⬥ Conservation of Energy </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697808773711921195.png?v=1" alt="conservationofenergy" title="conservationofenergy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (only if </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki>)
⬥ Demon Horn Necklace </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975765831248130079.png?v=1" alt="demonhornnecklace" title="demonhornnecklace" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Bonecrusher </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284344526602240.png?v=1" alt="bonecrusher" title="bonecrusher" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to upkeep prayer
⬥ Zuk cape </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626404192316.png?v=1" alt="igneouskalket" title="igneouskalket" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1153772938252787793.png?v=1" alt="igneouskalmej" title="igneouskalmej" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139200072438005851.png?v=1" alt="igneouskalmor" title="igneouskalmor" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626479685734.png?v=1" alt="igneouskalzuk" title="igneouskalzuk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (not needed for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki>)
⬥ Any cannon variant </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651405438997.png?v=1" alt="kineticcyclone" title="kineticcyclone" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651387613194.png?v=1" alt="oldakcoil" title="oldakcoil" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
⬥ Desolation / Anguish </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159018098713.png?v=1" alt="desolation" title="desolation" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936665198592.png?v=1" alt="anguish" title="anguish" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is active (only if Ranged)
⬥ Equilibrium aura </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1233722649834684416.png?v=1" alt="equilibriumaura" title="equilibriumaura" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is a good choice due to its duration
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
